## Summary of Changes

Brief description of what this PR does and the problem it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix/`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat/`)
- [ ] Refactoring / Layout cleanup (`refactor/`)
- [ ] Documentation update (`docs/`)
- [ ] Maintenance / Dependency bump (`chore/`)

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] All unit and integration tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] Added new tests covering modified code logic
- [ ] Code passes formatting and lint checks (`ruff check .`, `black --check .`)

## Checklist
- [ ] Follows branch naming convention (`<type>/<short-kebab-description>`)
- [ ] No sensitive or unredacted sample data committed
- [ ] API contracts and return types preserved
